Subject: Joint integration showcase — co-hosted webinar?

Hi Neha,

Following our chat at the Summit, Kernel AI would love to run a short co-hosted webinar highlighting our integration with Redwood Inference. High-level idea: a 30–40 minute session with a 15-minute customer/partner demo, 10 minutes product deep-dive, 10 minutes live Q&A. Goal: drive technical leads and seed a joint solution brief.

Proposed dates: Nov 30, Dec 7, or Dec 14 (US-friendly times).
What we can bring: landing page, 1 blog co-post, 2 social posts, small paid promo credit for targeted LinkedIn.

What we’d need from Redwood: one demo speaker (field or solutions), one product speaker (PM or engineering), event landing page + registrant capture hosted on Redwood domain, and approval for joint press copy. We’d also like to share registrant list with standard opt-in.

I attached a quick product one-pager so your team can match messaging.

Thoughts? If Nov 30 works we can draft a mutual action plan (MAP) and run logistics next week.

Best,
